correctness.rationale: For four independent endpoint-uniform circular points, the first chord midpoint has normalized planar density f(x)=[π²|x|sqrt(1-|x|²)]^-1. Exchangeability converts M1-M2 to half a four-step random walk; Borwein–Straub–Wan–Zudilin Example 4 has p4(s)~(3/(2π²))s log(1/s), giving Pr(E_eps)~(3/π²)eps²log(1/eps). A direct (radius,angle,scaled-displacement) Jacobian gives joint mark densities divided by eps² L tending to π^-4 at center and (2π⁴)^-1 at rim, with other t outside (0,1) vanishing almost everywhere. The resulting normalized limit integrates to 2/3+1/3=1, hence Scheffé proves joint total variation, not just weak convergence. Independent analytic squared-density log bands at eps=1e-12 have coefficients ≈0.03870186 and 0.01935791, confirming the 2:1 factor. The prior four-step marginal is explicitly excluded from novelty.
